title: Align the Threads view reply UI
summary: The root ask was to fix unbalanced/aligned UI when replying in Threads. Commit 59250b2 adds a shared inset for card header, fold link, replying line, and composer; it is an ancestor of both local main and origin/main. The sole reply reports desktop and phone screenshot checks and passing client gates G1–G7/G9, but G8 exceeded its CSS line ceiling. This is implemented, reported visually verified, and integrated/pushed; no live deployment evidence was found. Reply also leaves the .some crash awaiting a log/repro and phone unread-thread reply sizing and @ menu unchecked.
